training_domain: Structural Engineering - Reinforced Concrete Shear Wall (Placa) Design

case_study.wall_type: Irregular L-shaped structural shear wall (Placa irregular en L)

material_properties.note_on_upper_levels: Concrete strength may transition to 280 kg/cm2 from Level 5 upward if specified in the model, though 350 kg/cm2 is used across the full height in this workflow.

software_toolchain.name: ETABS (v2016/2018)
software_toolchain.role: 3D structural analysis, pier force extraction, lateral displacement check, preliminary wall reinforcing ratio, neutral axis depth (c), and compression stress extraction.

software_toolchain.name: AutoCAD
software_toolchain.role: Cross-section drafting, cover offsets, rebar placement layout, local-axis alignment rotation, polyline vertex extraction (LIST), and rebar coordinate extraction (DATAEXTRACTION).

software_toolchain.name: Microsoft Excel
software_toolchain.role: Preliminary boundary element sizing (PREDIMENSIONAMIENTO PM.xlsx), coordinate unit conversion (m to cm), and final flexo-compression & shear verification (11. Diseño de Muros Estructurales - Flexion-corte V1.0.xlsx).

software_toolchain.name: CSiCOL
software_toolchain.role: Irregular polygon section modeling, rebar arrangement definition, and generation of P-M interaction diagrams at 0° and 90°.

design_methodology_overview.strategy_for_irregular_walls: For an L-shaped wall with legs in both X and Y directions, first analyze and design each leg independently (P2b in Y, P2a in X) to size web steel and boundary elements, verify each leg individually, and finally unify both legs under a single Pier label (P2) in ETABS to verify the full composite L-section in CSiCOL and Excel.
design_methodology_overview.coordinate_alignment_rule: The green local axis 2 arrow of the Pier in ETABS must always point vertically upward (+Y) in the AutoCAD/CSiCOL section coordinate system. If ETABS local axis 2 points horizontally right, rotate the AutoCAD cross-section by 90 degrees before extracting coordinates so that 0° and 90° interaction curves match ETABS M2 and M3 moment directions.

step_by_step_workflow.phase: ETABS Isolation & Force Extraction for Individual Leg (P2b)
actions: Open the ETABS model where the L-wall legs are assigned separate pier labels (P2a and P2b).
Isolate the vertical leg: Select -> Labels -> Pier Labels -> select 'P2b' -> right-click -> 'Show Selected Objects Only'.
Ensure full height visibility: View -> Set Building View Limits -> Top Story: N12, Bottom Story: Base.
Extract preliminary forces: Press Ctrl + T -> Tables -> Analysis Results -> Wall Output -> Pier Forces.
Filter 'Load Case/Combo' for: Carga Muerta (CM), Carga Viva (CV), Sismo Diseño X Max/Min (SDX Max, SDX Min), and Sismo Diseño Y Max/Min (SDY Max, SDY Min).
Copy the filtered Pier Forces table and paste into the 'DATOS DE ETABS' sheet of 'PREDIMENSIONAMIENTO PM.xlsx'.

Verify that the pier name ('P2b') and load case names in the Excel lookup table match the pasted ETABS strings exactly (with 'Normal' spelling); check the 'COMBINACIONES' tab to confirm values populated.

step_by_step_workflow.phase: Preliminary Sizing & Boundary Element Calculation (PREDIMENSIONAMIENTO PM.xlsx)
actions: In the 'M. Rectangular' sheet, input material properties: fc = 350 kg/cm2, fy = 4200 kg/cm2.
Input wall leg geometry measured from AutoCAD: Length L = 150 cm, thickness b = 30 cm, total height H = 34.50 m (from ETABS Story Data: 33.25 m at N11 + 1.25 m basement).

Obtain top lateral displacement (delta_u) in ETABS: Display Deformed Shape for amplified design earthquake in the wall's primary direction ('SDY AMP' / 'DRIFT Y' for P2b), hover over the top node to read displacement = 4.6 cm.
Enter delta_u = 4.6 cm in Excel.

In ETABS, assign uniform reinforcing to P2b to obtain required steel ratio and neutral axis depth: Select P2b -> Design -> Shear Wall Design -> Assign Pier Sections -> Uniform Reinforcing -> Material: CONC350, Bar Size: #3 (3/8"), Spacing: 0.175 m, Corner/Edge Bar Size: #6 (3/4"), select 'Reinforcement to be Designed'.
Run Design Check: Shear Wall Design -> Start Design/Check (Shift + F10).
Display -> Design Info -> 'Pier Reinforcing Ratios'. Identify critical story (typically Base / bottom level).
Right-click the critical bottom pier to open 'ETABS 2016 Shear Wall Design' report and read:
- Required Reinforcing Ratio = 0.0051 (minimum ratio is 0.0025).
- Neutral axis depth (c) = max(0.4457 m, 0.55 m) = 55 cm.
- Compression stress (Stress Compress) = 852 Ton/m2.
Enter Required Ratio = 0.0051, Minimum Ratio = 0.0025, c = 55 cm, and Compression Stress = 852 Ton/m2 into Excel.
Read Excel design outputs:
- Web steel proposal: 2 layers (ramales) of 3/8" bars -> required spacing ~18 cm -> adopt 17.5 cm (@ 0.175 m).

- Boundary element requirement check: Excel confirms boundary element is required and calculates initial boundary length ~31.43 cm -> round to 30 cm initially (later increased to 40 cm for constructability/bar layout).
- Boundary element longitudinal steel area required = 7.02 cm2 -> propose 6 bars of 5/8" (provides 11.88 cm2 > 7.02 cm2; 7 bars used in symmetrical corner/end CAD layout).

step_by_step_workflow.phase: AutoCAD Section Drafting & Coordinate Extraction (Individual Leg P2b)
actions: Copy the structural wall outline from the master AutoCAD plan into a clean working file ('diseño placa p2.dwg').
Redraw wall perimeter polyline in the rebar/steel layer ('fierros'), then apply inward Offsets ('O'): 0.05 m (5 cm) and 0.03 m (3 cm) to establish cover and bar centerline guide.
Measure and mark boundary element zones of length 0.30 m initially; if the corner intersection creates tight/awkward spacing, extend boundary zones to 0.40 m (40 cm) for clean constructability.
Place circular markers ('Circle' blocks) for longitudinal bars: place bars at corners first, then distribute boundary element bars (e.g., 10 cm or 12.5 cm spacing for 3 bars along 0.25–0.40 m zone).

For the web (alma), place bars along the centerline offset at adopted spacing (0.175 m), then use 'Move' -> 'Mid Between 2 Points' (Shift + Right-Click) to center web bars symmetrically between boundary elements.
Create an individual file for leg P2b ('PL2B.dwg'): copy the L-wall, trim ('TR') to keep only leg P2b plus a small corner influence stub (40 cm flange return).
Move ('M') the bottom-left corner of P2b to world origin (0, 0, 0).
Run Data Extraction ('DX' / DATAEXTRACTION):
- Create new data extraction -> save template as 'PL2B.dxe'.
- Select Objects: check only 'Circle'.
- Select Properties: filter by 'Geometry' -> check only 'Center X' and 'Center Y'.
- Output data to external Excel file ('PL2B.xlsx').
Extract wall perimeter polygon vertices: run 'LIST' ('LI') on the outer wall polyline, copy the vertex coordinate lines from the AutoCAD text window.
Open 'PL2B.xlsx':
- Add bar designation column ('#3' for 3/8" base bars) and convert rebar Center X and Center Y from meters to centimeters (`=cell*100`).
- On a new sheet ('Hoja1'), paste the LIST output, run Excel 'Text to Columns' (Texto en columnas) to separate X and Y values, and multiply X and Y by 100 to convert to centimeters.

step_by_step_workflow.phase: CSiCOL Section Modeling & Flexo-Compression Verification (Individual Leg P2b)
actions: Open CSiCOL using an existing template ('PLACA P3.CSB'), delete the existing section shape, and save as a new project.
Click 'Add Polygon Shape by Coordinates' -> paste the wall polygon vertex X and Y coordinates (in cm) from Excel.
Double-click the polygon shape to open 'Shape Editor' -> click 'Edit Rebar' (Location of Rebars) -> paste Bar Size ('#3') and X, Y coordinates (in cm) from Excel.
In Shape Editor, select the boundary element corner/edge bars and change their diameter from #3 to #5 (5/8"). Click OK.
Generate Interaction Diagrams: click 'Display Interaction Diagram' -> set NA Angle to '0 Deg' -> click 'Show Output' -> Copy to Clipboard.
Open design workbook ('11. Diseño de Muros Estructurales - Flexion-corte V1.0.xlsx'), go to 'CSiCOL' sheet, and paste the 0° P-M curve.
Repeat in CSiCOL for NA Angle = '90 Deg' -> Copy to Clipboard -> paste into the 90° table in Excel.
In ETABS, filter 'Pier Forces' for design load combinations: Comb1, Comb2 (Max/Min), Comb3 (Max/Min), Comb4 (Max/Min), Comb5 (Max/Min). Copy and paste into 'ETABS SELECCIÓN' sheet.
Ensure lookup names in 'ETABS SELECCIÓN' match ('Comb1', 'Comb2 Max', 'Comb2 Min', ..., 'Comb5 Min') and check that 'ETABS DEFINITIVO' populates.
In 'HOJA DE CÁLCULO 1 EJE X':
- Set Pier = 'P2b', Story = 'N1' (or target level), L = 150 cm, b = 30 cm, fc = 350 kg/cm2, fy = 4200 kg/cm2.
- Inspect the 'DIAGRAMA A 0°' and 'DIAGRAMA A 90°' plots: verify that all orange points (ultimate demand combinations Pu, Mu) lie completely inside the blue design interaction envelope.
Result for P2b alone: All combinations fall inside both 0° and 90° curves (compliant).
Repeat Steps 1–4 identically for the other individual leg (P2a).

step_by_step_workflow.phase: Unified Full L-Shape Wall Verification & Iterative Redesign (P2 Complete)
actions: Open the unified ETABS model where both legs of the wall share a single Pier label 'P2' ('Modelo Final con placas de un solo pier.EDB').
Select Pier 'P2' and isolate it ('Show Selected Objects Only').
Check local axis orientation of P2 in ETABS plan view: the green local axis 2 points to the right (+X global) instead of up (+Y global).
In AutoCAD, take the full L-shaped wall with all drafted rebars and Rotate ('RO') it by 90 degrees so its orientation aligns with ETABS local axis 2 pointing upward.
Move ('M') the bottom-left reference corner of the rotated L-wall to world origin (0, 0, 0) and save as a new drawing.
Run DATAEXTRACTION ('DX') for all circles -> export to 'P2COMPLETE.xlsx'. Run 'LIST' on the full L-polygon -> copy vertices to 'Hoja1' and convert all X, Y coordinates to centimeters (*100).
In CSiCOL, save project as 'P2 COMPLETE.CSB', clear old section, paste the full L-polygon vertex coordinates (cm), and paste all rebar coordinates (#3 base) (cm).
Assign initial boundary bar sizes in CSiCOL Shape Editor: #5 (5/8") at all three boundary element regions (left/bottom end, central corner, right/top end) and #3 (3/8") in the web segments.
Export 0° and 90° interaction curves from CSiCOL and paste into a new Excel workbook ('P1 COMPLETO.xlsx' / 'P2 COMPLETO.xlsx').
Extract 'Comb1' through 'Comb5 Max/Min' Pier Forces for unified Pier 'P2' from ETABS and paste into 'ETABS SELECCIÓN'. Set Pier = 'P2' in calculation sheet.
Evaluate initial interaction diagrams: Orange load points exceed/fall outside the blue interaction curve at 0° -> Design FAILS flexo-compression.
Iterative Reinforcement Upgrade in CSiCOL:
- Iteration 1: Upgrade boundary element bars in the central/corner and upper/left flange boundary zones from #5 (5/8") to #6 (3/4"). Re-export 0° & 90° curves -> still slightly insufficient at 0°.

- Iteration 2: Upgrade web bars in the upper/vertical leg from #3 (3/8") to #4 (1/2") and verify corner/boundary distribution (matching final CAD detail: 12Ø3/4" at corner, 8Ø5/8" at left/bottom end, 8Ø3/4" at right end, web 1Ø1/2"@.175 / @.10, hoops/ties Ø3/8"@.10).
- Re-export 0° & 90° curves to Excel and inspect plots until all demand points fall within the capacity envelope (add individual extra edge bars in CSiCOL if borderline points remain).

initial_P2b_proposal.boundary_elements: 6 to 7 bars Ø5/8" (11.88 cm2 provided vs 7.02 cm2 required)

upgraded_full_L_wall_P2.web_steel: Ø1/2" @ 0.175 m (and @ 0.10 m in high-demand leg) / Ø3/8" @ 0.175 m

key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.issue: Excel lookup cells show #N/A or fail to pull ETABS Pier Forces
key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.solution: Check that the Pier label string in Excel (e.g., 'P2b' vs 'P2') and Load Case/Combination names exactly match the text strings pasted from ETABS.

key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.issue: ETABS Pier Forces table appears empty after Ctrl + T
key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.solution: Ensure the Pier objects are actively selected in the ETABS viewport before pressing Ctrl + T, or verify Building View Limits include all stories from Base to Top.

key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.issue: Boundary element length of 30 cm leaves awkward rebar clearance near L-wall corner
key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.solution: Increase boundary element length to 40 cm in AutoCAD for cleaner bar spacing and tie placement.

key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.issue: 0° and 90° interaction diagram moments do not match ETABS M2 and M3 axes for rotated/L-walls
key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.solution: Inspect ETABS local axis 2 (green arrow) orientation in plan view and rotate the AutoCAD section before coordinate extraction so local axis 2 points strictly upward (+Y).

key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.issue: Demand points fall outside the CSiCOL interaction diagram in Excel
key_agent_rules_and_troubleshooting.solution: Identify which angle (0° or 90°) fails, increase bar diameters in CSiCOL Shape Editor (e.g., boundary #5 -> #6, web #3 -> #4) or add extra bars at high-stress edges, re-export curves, and re-check.
